register.name: LUCID Verpackungsregister
register.notes: Registration is free and done directly in LUCID (no local establishment required historically under VerpackG). VerpackDG (national PPWR adaptation act) in force 12.08.2026 — re-verify whether an authorised representative becomes mandatory for foreign distance sellers. LUCID number is issued ~24h after registration and must be entered in Amazon/eBay seller accounts.

pro.ecoModulation: VerpackG §21 requires dual systems to set incentives for recyclability and recycled content; concrete bonus/malus differs per system.

thresholds.deMinimis: 0 kg — first unit placed on the German market triggers registration and system participation

notes: Dual-system (PRO) contract is MANDATORY before the first supply of household packaging; LUCID registration alone is not compliance. Rate data intentionally null: public sources conflict (€0.6–1.0/kg vs €1.6–2.1/kg for plastic) — resolve against a real dual-system price list (e.g. Lizenzero public calculator) before publishing rates.
